bullets.text: Heavy overnight rain caused waterlogging, uprooted trees and damaged roads across Chennai, and the office should monitor drainage and road restoration efforts.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay instructed District Collectors to take precautionary flood measures amid the monsoon, and the office should watch disaster preparedness statewide.
Authorities issued a tender to prepare a detailed project report for an elevated road from Lighthouse to Adyar bridge, and the office should track project progress.
Residents reported severe mosquito nuisance at a large mall in the 174th ward of Velachery, and the office should direct local health authorities to clear stagnation.
Garbage stagnation in drains at the Gummidipoondi SIPCOT industrial area caused health concerns for workers, and the office should coordinate immediate sanitation cleanups.
Migrant workers fell ill after eating mushrooms near Ponneri, and the office should monitor medical treatment provided to the affected workers.
Commuters in Thiruvallur urged officials to operate the Chennai to Arakkonam suburban express train with 12 coaches, and the office should coordinate with railway authorities.
Bihar targeted AI training for five lakh youth under its proposed policy, and the office should review state skilling initiatives in comparison.
Analysts highlighted the urgent need for India to establish an AI defence force with mandatory incident reporting, and the office should note national cybersecurity debates.
